title: [Master]-Purchase invoice lines of type G/L Account where enabling 'Prices Including VAT' and changing the VAT Prod. Posting Group causes recalculation of the Direct Unit Cost Incl. VAT and Line Amount - Related to Bug  632380
summary: Fixed an issue where changing the VAT product posting group on G/L account lines in purchase invoices with prices including VAT incorrectly recalculated the direct unit cost and line amount.
key_points: Corrects VAT recalculation logic for G/L account purchase lines
Ensures prices including VAT are preserved when changing VAT posting groups
Updates tests to validate the corrected behavior
